value.title: Grand Théâtre de Bordeaux
value.snippet: The Grand Théâtre de Bordeaux (French pronunciation: [ɡʁɑ̃ teɑtʁ də bɔʁdo]) is an opera house in Bordeaux, France, first inaugurated on 17 April 1780.
